name: Daiba Nana
source:
"I need to go... I have a score to settle."

She is [url=/c133940]Junna[/url]'s roommate, and at the same time, a Stage Girl with extraordinary talent in both performing and stage creation. She often has the chance to bake together with [url=/c133941]Mahiru[/url], and she is affectionately nicknamed "Banana". She loves everyone who helps to create the stage together, and that is the reason why she sometimes shows a ruthless side.

[From [url=https://revuestarlight.bushiroadgames.com/en/character/nana/]official website[/url]]
